editorial:
Imagine being so charming that three fairy tale princesses all think you are their one true love. That is the wild setup behind this animated adventure, and it is just as fun as it sounds. You follow Prince Charming as he juggles secret engagements with Snow White, Cinderella, and Sleeping Beauty, all while a curse threatens to ruin everything. The movie leans hard into comedy, poking fun at classic fairy tale tropes with a wink and a smile. The animation is bright and colorful, the voice cast brings plenty of energy, and the pacing keeps things moving so you never feel bored. It is the kind of movie that works great for a family movie night when you want something light and silly.

On the plus side, the jokes land often, the characters are likable, and the story has a sweet message about being true to yourself. On the downside, some of the humor feels a little familiar, and the plot can be predictable if you have seen a lot of animated fairy tale comedies. Still, it is a fun ride with enough heart to keep you smiling. If you have kids or just want a breezy watch, stream it in 4K Ultra HD on Prime Video, rent it on Apple TV, or grab the 4K Blu-ray for the best picture quality.
endingExplained: In the final act, Prince Charming's secret engagements are exposed, and the three princesses turn against him. He must team up with a thief named Lenore to break the curse that makes him irresistible to everyone. In the end, Charming learns to be honest and genuine rather than relying on his charm. He chooses Lenore, who saw the real him, and the princesses find their own paths. The curse is lifted, and Charming finally gets a true happy ending built on honesty instead of magic.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves animated fairy tale comedies and family movie nights.
